summary: Markets are broadly risk-on after the U.S. midterm outcome: Bitcoin and Ethereum rebounded above $80,000 and $2,400, while gold rallied as the dollar and Treasury yields weakened.[3][6][9] Oil is sharply bearish after an abrupt weekly decline tied to expectations of reduced Middle East escalation, while AI-related equities are under pressure despite broader global-market gains.[1][5][8]
